description: Brain-only escape-circuit response: bilateral Poisson drive of LC4=LPLC2 (Hz) -> mean DNp01 (Giant Fiber) firing rate (Hz), via the real v783 wiring (no body). The silenced variant knocks out LC4/LPLC2 to show the response is routed entirely through them.

units.input_hz: Hz Poisson drive per VPN type (LC4 and LPLC2 equal)
units.dnp01_hz: Hz mean Giant Fiber firing rate

method: live, persistent build_looming_drive network stepped per point (1 s window); silenced = second build with LC4/LPLC2 synapses zeroed

channels_at_150hz.summation: sub-additive (LC4_only + LPLC2_only >> both): the Giant Fiber sums size + velocity with diminishing returns
